GOAT GORGE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-goatgorge.txt.

A little goat climbs a gorge to the summit, one screen at a time: run, jump, slide down walls and jump off
them, dash once in the air in any direction. A fall puts you back at the room's start at once. Five
chapters, a berry hidden in most rooms, and your best time and fewest deaths are kept.

Run GoatGorge.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  run, aim the dash         D-pad                      arrows
  jump (hold: higher)       A (or X)                   X
  dash                      B (or Y, L, R)             Z
  fast-fall                 Down                       Down
  pause / resume            Start or Select            Enter, Backspace or Esc
  paused: back to title     B                          Z
  choose a chapter          Left / Right on the title  arrows

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: GoatGorge.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The records are saved in goatgorge.srm next to the exe.
